name: flagforge
description: Self-hosted feature flags with real-time streaming and native SDKs for React and Vue

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,dashboard -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @flagforge/server" "npm run dev -w @flagforge/dashboard"
scripts.dev:examples: concurrently -n react,vue -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w react-demo" "npm run dev -w vue-demo"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @flagforge/dashboard && npm run build -w @flagforge/server
